notes: Made by Shanghai, per the contributor (2026-10-22). Direct counts: barrel 96; second wheel 75 with 15 leaves on the near steel section and 16 on the far section; third 64/10; fourth 72/8; escape 20/8. Peter Hudson corrected the near-section count on 2026-10-21; recount confirms 15. He confirmed the far 16-leaf section meshes with the barrel and the near 15-leaf section meshes with the dial-side motion works. The pinion field records the 16-leaf barrel input; the separate 15-leaf section is documented here. All periods derive from these counts and the contributor-confirmed 21600 vph beat rate. The centre-wheel slot denotes the second wheel; its one-hour period is calculated, not independently timed. Barrel drum period is 21600 s (6 h), not power reserve. Lift angle, seconds-hand arrangement and the exact motion-works mating wheel remain unspecified. Genuine Patek records are outside this contribution.

sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_standard_movement (Wikipedia: "a minimum of 17 jewels, 21,600 bph (beats per hour) escapement") ()
https://chinesewatchwiki.net/Tongji (Chinese Watch Wiki: "a manual-wind, 21,600 bph watch movement"; names SZ-1 (prototype), SS7 (Shanghai), ZB-1 (Beijing) and ZSE (Shanghai No. 2)) ()
notes: The unified movement (统一机芯, Tongji) designed in 1971 by a group from several factories and made across China: hand-wound, centre seconds, at least 17 jewels, at least 40 h. Factory versions differ in finish, jewels and date, and some are thinner (SS8, SB1H, ZB2) or larger (Jilin HJ1A, a pocket-watch size); those are not listed here because no source ties them to the same beat rate. The hand-wound export name 2650 is left out because it collides with the ETA 2650. No lift angle is published.

sources: https://chinesewatchwiki.net/SS1 (Chinese Watch Wiki: "The first variant, the SS1A, with a 18,000 bph escapement") ()
